items.title: Commencement
notes:
A meeting of City Council was held at 4;04 p.m. this date, chaired by Mayor B. Vrbanovic. Notice of this meeting had been previously given to all members of Council by the City Clerk pursuant to Chapter 25 (Council Procedure) of the Municipal Code.

The meeting began with a Land Acknowledgement given by the Mayor.

items.title: Disclosure of Pecuniary Interest and the General Nature Thereof
AMCTO Executive Diploma in Municipal Management (EDMM) Equity scholarship - City of Kitchener Grant Recipient - Mariah Blake
notes: Mayor B. Vrbanovic acknowledged Mariah Blake, Committee Coordinator, City of Kitchener for receipt of the Association of Municipal Clerks and Treasurers of Ontario (AMCTO)'s Executive Diploma in Municipal Management (EDMM) Equity scholarship.

In-camera Meeting Authorization
notes: At the request of the City Clerk, Council agreed to amend the in-camera resolution for item 7.3 to allow for "Information (e.g., a trade secret or scientific, technical, commercial, or financial information) that belongs to the municipality and has monetary value [s. 239(2)(j)] as an additional reason for closed session, to be included as an additional closed session exemption for that matter.

items.title: Recess and Reconvene
notes: The Special Council meeting recessed at 4:08 p.m. and reconvened at 8:10 p.m., chaired by Mayor B. Vrbanovic, with all members present, save and except for Councillor A. Owodunni.

motions.item_title: Preapproval of Funding - 2027 Fleet Capital - Three (3) Units, INS-2026-321
motions.text: "That Council pre-approve funding in the amount of $831,978 from the Fleet Equipment Reserve to support the purchase of three (3) replacements of assets that failed prior to meeting their expected lifecycle, as outlined in Infrastructure Services Department Report INS-2026-321; and, That Brandt Tractor Ltd, Cambridge, Ontario, be the sole source provider for One (1) Used Motor Grader, at their quoted price of $311,640, plus H.S.T of $40,513.20, for a total of $352,153.20; and further, That Joe Johnson Equipment, Innisfill, Ontario, be the sole source provider for Two (2) Trackless Municipal Tractors with winter and summer equipment., at their quoted price of $520,338.59, plus H.S.T of $67,644, for a total of $587,952.59."

motions.text: "That an in-camera meeting of City Council be held immediately following the special council meeting this date to consider a solicitor client privilege matter, a plan and instruction for negotiations and a labour relations matter and Information (e.g., a trade secret or scientific, technical, commercial, or financial information) that belongs to the municipality and has monetary value as authorized by Sections 239 (2) (d) (f) (j) and (k) of the Municipal Act, 2001, respectively."

motions.item_title: City Facility - Funding Update (Plans and instructions for negotiations - Section 239(2) (k))
motions.text: "That staff be authorized to proceed with negotiations as outlined in Report CSD-2026-324 and in accordance with the direction provided by Council at its in-camera meeting held August 10, 2026; and, further, That, subject to successful negotiations that the General Manager, Infrastructure Services Department, be authorized to execute necessary documentation, in a form satisfactory to the City Solicitor."
